provenance.pixelCoordinates: Approximate original-image screen pixels: x rightward, y downward. They are inventory locations, not physical quantities.

inventory.description: One upright thick rectangular outline. Approximate outer bounds x=13..325, y=29..376; interior sides near x=23 and x=313, floor near y=363. No second apparatus or separate subfigure.
relationships: The rod passes through the top.
The piston spans nearly the interior width.
The dense liquid is below the piston and above the floor.

inventory.description: One thick dark vertical central rod, approximately x=145..187, y=12..224, attached to one dark horizontal piston, approximately x=25..312, y=217..269. The rod extends above the top outline. The piston is well above the floor.
relationships: Piston lies horizontally across the container.
Rod divides the white space above the piston into left and right visible areas; these are not separate figure panels.

inventory.description: A dense layer of white near-circular outlines occupies approximately x=24..313, y=269..363. Centers are staggered and irregular, roughly five visual height bands rather than an exact row-column grid. Some edge outlines are truncated; some strokes are open or connected to neighboring white space; arrows cross several outlines. No visible lattice lines or bonds.
inventory.countStatus: UNRESOLVED: an exact count cannot be asserted from these pixels without interpreting open, arrow-obscured, and boundary-connected strokes.

ambiguousExamples.reason: A large white component above the piston is joined through gaps to parts of the left particle layer.
Multiple particle interiors and interstitial spaces form one connected white component, so component count is not molecule count.
An arrow and neighboring open outlines prevent a reliable one-component-to-one-particle assignment.
Wall-connected and truncated edge outlines share white space.
Bottom-row circular and interstitial white regions are connected.

pixelComponentAid.method: Original grayscale threshold: white >180; four-neighbor connected components; no closure for the retained primary observation.
pixelComponentAid.interpretation: This includes molecule interiors, compound regions and interstices. It is explicitly NOT a particle count.
pixelComponentAid.interpretationOfSensitivity: Changing gap closure changes the region count; none is an authorized source molecule count.

relationships: All depicted liquid particles are below the piston.
No particle appears in the upper white areas.
The irregular local packing is not a periodic crystal lattice.
inventory.mappingStatus: HOLD: no numerical objectCount or guessed particle layout authored.

inventory.description: Seven discernible thick directed arrows occur inside the particle layer. All have a downward component in this selected two-dimensional source view. They are not force arrows on the rod and are not arrows between separate panels.
inventory.endpointMeaning: Approximate visual tails and heads in local particle neighborhoods, not measured displacement vectors or uniquely identified particle transitions.
inventory.mappingStatus: Planned source mapping only; no executable spec or approved assertion exists.

inventory.description: One source figure panel. No readable text, lettered molecule, number, unit, legend, quantitative axis, tick, scale, grid, bond network, drawn cage boundary or time sequence is present. White areas above the piston have no assigned substance label.

modernQualificationMapping.sourceFact: Close near-circular particles and local arrows.
modernQualificationMapping.approvedTextConstraint: Neighboring molecules form a temporary cage; neighbors also move; rearrangements are qualitative.
modernQualificationMapping.justifiedAddition: An English temporary-neighbor or local-rearrangement label could qualify the diagram without inventing a permanent cage or lattice.
modernQualificationMapping.notAuthorized: A periodic grid, fixed neighbor bonds, a measured hop length, a numerical timing constant, or reducing the glyph count for readability.

modernQualificationMapping.sourceFact: The seven selected arrows all have downward components.
modernQualificationMapping.approvedTextConstraint: An isotropic liquid at rest with no directional driving has no overall directed flow.
modernQualificationMapping.justifiedAddition: An explicit English qualification that selected local directions do not represent a net flow would be necessary if these source directions are retained.
modernQualificationMapping.notAuthorized: Silently deleting the original arrows, reversing arrows and calling that source fidelity, or interpreting the source as a bulk downward flow.

decision.reason: Exact preservation of all source counts is required, but several overlapping/open glyphs cannot be unambiguously assigned to individual particles. Rendering an invented regularized population would not be justified.
